section.content: The invention provides a semiconductor device and a semiconductor integrated circuit, which comprises an element isolation region (14), a convex semiconductor region (11), and gate electrodes formed on both side surfaces and the upper surface of a part of the convex semiconductor region, and a plurality of first gate electrodes (12A) formed between a pair of opposite ends of the element isolation region, the first gate electrodes being formed between the plurality of first gate electrodes on the same layer as the plurality of first gate electrodes, at least one second gate electrode (12B) for applying a voltage to turn off the transistor, and a source region and a drain region formed in the semiconductor region on both sides of the first gate electrode and the second gate electrode, a transistor having a second gate electrode to which a voltage to be turned off is applied is arranged between transistors having first gate electrodes, so that heat generation in the transistor is reduced without lowering the saturation current of the transistor.

本发明提供种半导体装置以及半导体集成电路，具有元件分离区域(14)、凸状的半导体区域(11)、形成于凸状的半导体区域的部分的两个侧面以及上表面的栅电极，且是形成在元件分离区域的对置的对端部之间的多个第栅电极(12A)、在与多个第栅电极相同的层形成在多个第栅电极之间，并施加将晶体管设为截止状态的电压的至少个第二栅电极(12B)以及源极区域和漏极区域，形成于第栅电极和第二栅电极的两侧的凸状的半导体区域，在具有第栅电极的晶体管之间，配置具有施加成为截止状态的电压的第二栅电极的晶体管，从而不降低晶体管的饱和电流而减少晶体管中的发热。
